title: Mina and the little kitten
text:
Mina was walking home from school. It was a hot day, and her bag was heavy.

Then she heard a small sound. "Mew, mew." Mina stopped. The sound came from under a green bush.

She looked under the bush. A little grey kitten was sitting there. It looked thin and wet.

"Hello," said Mina in a soft voice. "Are you lost?"

The kitten came out and rubbed its head on her shoe. Mina gave it a drink of water from her bottle. The kitten drank and drank.

Mina did not want to leave the kitten. She picked it up and carried it home. Her mum said, "Poor little kitten. We can look after it until we find its home."

That night, the kitten slept in a box next to Mina's bed. It was warm and safe. Mina smiled and went to sleep.
